description: Rail Intercity Routes is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Intercity passenger rail services provide transportation between metropolitan areas, to rural areas of California, and to points beyond California’s borders. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Rail, Clearinghouse, Rail Intercity Routes, CAOpenData, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -122.3602,32.7157,-117.1700,38.9037. The hub shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the hub listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
